title: columns block props
description: Columns (« Colonnes »): two or three columns of blocks side by side (slots first, second, third), stacked in reading order on narrow screens. Use it for content read side by side: two cases compared, a figure and its explanation, three short points.
x-ai-instructions: Columns for content the learner compares or reads together, each column short (a heading, a paragraph, an image). Reading order is first, then second, then third: write each column so it reads after the one before when they stack on a phone. Not for long text: a column narrower than about 45 characters is hard to read. With count 2, put nothing in third.

x-slots.label: First column
x-slots.description: The first column (left in left-to-right languages).

widths.description: equal; wide-start: the first column is twice as wide; wide-end: the last column is twice as wide.

align.description: Vertical alignment of the columns: at their top, or centred on each other.
